|game_text=Deploy on [[Yavin 4 (V) (Virtual Block 7){{!}}Yavin 4]]; it is 'liberated.' At sites related to other 'liberated' systems, may add 2 to power of each Rebel warrior (to a maximum of 4). Once per turn, while you control this system, may retrieve 1 Force when you Force drain at another 'liberated' system.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Massassi Base Sentry]]. Other errata versions: [[Massassi Base Sentry (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Massassi Base Sentry (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, the current text). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-04-Massassi_Base_Sentry-PC-E2-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-massassibasesentry-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-04-Massassi_Base_Sentry.png]]) show the PC-E1 text (see [[Massassi Base Sentry (Errata)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Massassi Base Sentry]]): first printing of the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010): “Deploy on Yavin 4 system; it is 'liberated'. At sites related to other 'liberated' systems, may add 2 to power of each Rebel warrior (to a maximum of 4). Once per turn, if you control this system, may retrieve 1 Force when you Force drain at another 'liberated' system.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010), page 8, slip 40 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref> That first printing is not preserved; the text is the re-made sheet's text with “Yavin 4 system”, which the Players Committee news post of 28 June 2010 corrected to “Yavin 4”.<ref name="src-S3">Players Committee news post "Some minor errors and clarifications", 28 June 2010. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100714025225/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=244:some-minor-errors-and-clarifications&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Massassi Base Sentry (Errata)]]): The Players Committee news post "Some minor errors and clarifications" (28 June 2010) changed “Deploy on Yavin 4 system” to “Deploy on Yavin 4”: “Deploy on Yavin 4; it is 'liberated'. At sites related to other 'liberated' systems, may add 2 to power of each Rebel warrior (to a maximum of 4). Once per turn, if you control this system, may retrieve 1 Force when you Force drain at another 'liberated' system.”<ref name="src-S3" /> The re-made Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (copy re-made 28 July 2010) prints this text.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1" />
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “it is 'liberated'.” to “it is 'liberated.'” and “if you control this system” to “while you control this system”: “Deploy on Yavin 4; it is 'liberated.' At sites related to other 'liberated' systems, may add 2 to power of each Rebel warrior (to a maximum of 4). Once per turn, while you control this system, may retrieve 1 Force when you Force drain at another 'liberated' system.”<ref name="cl-1271_40-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> (Corrected 8 November 2026: this page had “During battle at sites…”, a text from the Players Committee card data that the card list never showed.)
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Massassi Base Sentry (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “At sites” to “During battles at sites” and “while you control” back to “if you control”: “Deploy on Yavin 4; it is 'liberated'. During battles at sites related to other 'liberated' systems, may add 2 to power of each Rebel warrior (to a maximum of 4). Once per turn, if you control this system, may retrieve 1 Force when you Force drain at another 'liberated' system.”<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=26, page 26. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=26 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee announced this text on 13 April 2013, effective immediately, to make the power bonus an optional action that lasts only for that battle (the post prints “'liberated.'”)<ref name="pcforum-p802181">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 13 April 2013 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p802181 Internet Archive copy], captured 20 March 2015)</ref>.
